title: A Carolina trumpet creeper
done: You made a trumpet creeper! Hummingbirds visit its red trumpet flowers.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table. It is the vine.
Put another green square under it. The vine grows down.
Put a tall red triangle above the vine, pointing left. The trumpet!
Put a red square next to the wide end of the triangle, above the vine.
Put an orange square next to the red one.
Put an orange triangle on top. The trumpet opens wide.
Put an orange triangle at the bottom. Now it is wide open.
